description_en: Queries the details of an alert by alert ID
description_zh: 调用GetAlertMessage接口，通过获取的AlertId查询报警信息
name: GetAlertMessage

parameters.help_en: The alert ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173961.html operation to obtain the alert ID
parameters.name: alert_id

Data.description_en: The details of the returned data

AlertMessageStatus.description_en:
The sending status of the alert message. Valid values:
READY_TO_SEND: The message is ready to be sent.
SEND_FAIL: The message fails to be sent.
SEND_SUCCESS: The message is sent.
SEND_OVERLIMIT: The alert limit is exceeded
AlertMessageStatus.description_zh:
报警信息的发送状态。取值如下：
READY_TO_SEND（准备发送）
SEND_FAIL（发送失败）
SEND_SUCCESS（发送成功）
SEND_OVERLIMIT（报警超限）

AlertMethod.description_en:
The alert notification method. Valid values:
MAIL: Email.
SMS: Text message.
PHONE: Phone call. This method is supported only in DataWorks Professional Edition and later
AlertMethod.description_zh:
报警方式。取值如下：
MAIL（邮件）
SMS（短信）
PHONE（电话，仅DataWorks专业版及以上版本支持）

AlertTime.description_en: The time when the alert is triggered. The value is a 13-digit timestamp, such as `1553524393000`
AlertTime.description_zh:
报警时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1553524393000`

AlertUser.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the alert message recipient
AlertUser.description_zh: 报警信息接收人的阿里云UID

Content.description_en: The content of the alert message

Instances.description_en: The list of instances that trigger the custom monitoring rule. This parameter is returned only when the Source parameter is set to REMIND_ALERT. For other alert sources, an empty list is returned
Instances.description_zh: 当Source（报警来源）为REMIND_ALERT（自定义提醒）时，返回触发自定义监控规则的实例列表。其它类型的报警来源返回为空

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the node belongs

Status.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
NOT_RUN: The instance is not run.
WAIT_TIME: The instance is waiting for the scheduled time.
WAIT_RESOURCE: The instance is waiting for resources.
RUNNING: The instance is running.
CHECKING: The instance is being checked.
CHECKING_CONDITION: The conditions are being checked.
FAILURE: The instance failed to run.
SUCCESS: The instance runs successfully
Status.description_zh:
实例状态。取值如下：
NOT_RUN（未运行）
WAIT_TIME（等待时间）
WAIT_RESOURCE（等待资源）
RUNNING（运行中）
CHECKING（校检中）
CHECKING_CONDITION（条件检测中）
FAILURE（运行失败）
SUCCESS（运行成功）

Nodes.description_en:
The returned node list varies based on the alert source:
If Source is NODE_CYCLE_ALERT (cyclic node alert), the types of cyclic nodes are returned.
If Source is NODELONELYALERT (isolated node alert), the types of isolated nodes are returned
Nodes.description_zh:
不同的报警来源返回不同的节点列表：
当Source（报警来源）为NODE_ CYCLE_ALERT（节点成环报警）时，返回成环的节点类型。
当Source（报警来源）为NODELONELYALERT（节点孤立报警）时，返回孤立的节点类型

Owner.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the node owner

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the node belongs

RemindId.description_en: The ID of the custom monitoring rule that triggers the alert. This parameter is returned only when the Source parameter is set to REMIND_ALERT
RemindId.description_zh: 当Source（报警来源）为REMIND_ALERT（自定义报警）时，返回触发的自定义监控规则ID

RemindName.description_en: The name of the custom monitoring rule that triggers the alert. This parameter is returned only when the Source parameter is set to REMIND_ALERT
RemindName.description_zh: 当Source（报警来源）为REMIND_ALERT（自定义提醒）时，返回触发的自定义监控规则名称

SlaAlert.description_en: The basic information about the baseline instance that triggers the baseline alert. This parameter is returned only when the Source parameter is set to SLA_ALERT. For other alert sources, this parameter is empty
SlaAlert.description_zh: 当Source（报警来源）为SLA_ALERT（基线报警）时，返回触发基线预警的基本实例信息。当报警来源为其它类型时，返回为空

BaselineOwner.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud UIDs of the baseline owners. Multiple UIDs are separated by commas (,)
BaselineOwner.description_zh: 基线责任人的阿里云UID，多个UID之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔

Bizdate.description_en: The timestamp of the business date for the baseline instance
Bizdate.description_zh: 基线实例的业务日期时间戳

InGroupId.description_en: The cycle number of the baseline instance. The value is 1 for daily baselines and ranges from 1 to 24 for hourly baselines
InGroupId.description_zh: 基线实例的周期号：天基线为1，小时基线范围为[1,24]

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the baseline belongs

Status.description_en:
The baseline status. Valid values:
ERROR: Abnormal.
SAFE: Safe.
DANGEROUS: Warning.
OVER: Broken
Status.description_zh:
基线状态。取值如下：
ERROR（异常）
SAFE（安全）
DANGEROUS（预警）
OVER（破线）

Source.description_en:
The source of the alert. Valid values:
REMIND_ALERT: Custom alert.
TOPIC_ALERT: Event alert.
SLA_ALERT: Baseline alert.
NODE_CYCLE_ALERT: Node loop alert.
NODE_LONELY_ALERT: Isolated node alert
Source.description_zh:
报警来源。取值如下：
REMIND_ALERT（自定义报警）
TOPIC_ALERT（事件报警）
SLA_ALERT（基线预警）
NODE_CYCLE_ALERT（节点成环报警）
NODE_LONELY_ALERT（节点孤立报警）

Topics.description_en: The list of events that trigger the alerting. This parameter is returned only when the Source parameter is set to TOPIC_ALERT (global event alerting). For other alerting sources, an empty list is returned
Topics.description_zh: 当Source（报警来源）为TOPIC_ALERT（全局事件告警）时，返回触发报警的事件列表。当报警来源为其它类型时，返回结果为空

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID associated with the event

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the node associated with the event

TopicOwner.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the event owner

TopicStatus.description_en:
The status of the event. Valid values:
IGNORE: The event is ignored.
NEW: The event is newly discovered.
FIXING: The event is being handled.
RECOVER: The event is recovered
TopicStatus.description_zh:
事件的状态。取值如下：
IGNORE（已忽略）
NEW（新发现）
FIXING（处理中）
RECOVER（已恢复）

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the request ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Specifies whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
